subject: ela
intro: In a good discussion, you come prepared (having read the material), follow agreed rules, carry out your assigned role, ask and answer questions to deepen the talk, and build on others' ideas by linking your comments to theirs. Fourth graders take part thoughtfully and keep the discussion moving.

items.prompt: Your group will discuss a chapter. What should you do BEFORE the discussion to come prepared?

steps: Being prepared means reading and thinking ahead.
You should read the chapter and note your ideas or questions.
So you read the chapter and bring notes/questions.
solution.answer: Read the chapter and bring ideas or questions.

items.prompt: A classmate says, 'The hero was selfish at first.' You say, 'That connects to what I noticed, how he changed after helping the old man.' What are you doing?

steps: You linked your comment to the classmate's idea and added to it.
That is building on their idea.
So you are building on their idea.

items.prompt: In a group, your assigned role is 'summarizer.' What should you do?

steps: A summarizer gives a short recap of the main points.
So you summarize the group's main points.
solution.answer: Give a short summary of the main points.

items.prompt: Coming to a discussion ready is being ____.
Linking your comment to a classmate's is ____ on their idea.
